transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi… thanks. I guess what brought me in is my sleep has been kind of all over the place lately. I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, but I’ll either be up half the night with my mind just going, or I wake up way too early and feel like I didn’t really rest at all. It’s starting to bother me enough that I thought I should probably talk to someone.
Can you tell me if these sleep issues happen even when you have a good chance to get enough rest, like when you don’t have any distractions or reasons to stay up late?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, it’s not just when I’m out late or on my phone or something. Even when I have time to sleep and nothing really stopping me, I’ll still end up lying there half the night with my mind running, or I’ll wake up really early and feel like I didn’t rest. It’s been… kind of messed up, I guess.
Have you noticed yourself feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy around the same time your sleep started getting worse?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but I have been feeling pretty low. Lately I’ll wake up with this heavy, kind of empty feeling, and it’s hard to shake. Like, even sitting in my own condo — which I worked really hard for — sometimes just makes me want to cry. I don’t know if that’s the kind of thing you mean.
Have you noticed feeling down or having a depressed mood most of the day, nearly every day, recently?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I don’t want to overstate it, but lately a lot of days I wake up with this really heavy, empty feeling. And sometimes I’ll just be sitting in my condo — which I worked really hard to have — and I’ll feel like I’m about to cry. So… yes, I guess that probably counts?
Have you found that things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or activities, don’t feel as rewarding or interesting lately?

Yeah… I guess so. I mean, it’s not like I never want to do anything, but… I stopped going to salsa class, which I used to really like. And my paints are still sitting out on the table at home, but I just look at them and feel nothing, like they belong to somebody else. That sounds kind of dramatic, sorry, but… yeah, it’s been like that.
Have you noticed a big drop in your energy lately, or been feeling unusually tired even when you haven’t done much?

Yeah… I think there has been a drop. I mean, I’m still getting myself to work and everything, so it’s not like I’m completely useless, but even after I’ve been in bed all night, just walking from the parking lot into the office feels like I’m dragging sandbags. And by lunchtime my brain feels kind of… worn out already. Does that make sense?
Have you been feeling like you're not good enough or blamed yourself for things more than usual lately?

Yeah… I mean, I try not to get dramatic about it, because things are technically okay. No bill is late or anything. But I keep telling myself I was stupid to take on the mortgage, like I should’ve known better, and that I’ve let everyone down somehow. Which… I know maybe doesn’t totally make sense, but it’s been hard to stop thinking that.
Have you ever felt so low that you’ve thought about hurting yourself or that life wasn’t worth living?

Um… no, I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve felt really low and kind of overwhelmed, but I haven’t been thinking about hurting myself or anything like that. It’s more like… I just want things to feel easier, if that makes sense.
How long have you been feeling this way overall? Has it been going on for at least a couple of weeks?

Yeah… definitely more than a couple weeks. I guess if I’m being honest, this kind of low, guilty fog has been around for maybe five months or so. It got a lot worse after I bought the condo, but it wasn’t like it came out of nowhere that day. I don’t know if that’s the kind of timeframe you mean.
Have you ever had a period of time before this one where you felt this kind of low or lost interest in things for a few weeks or more?

I’m not totally sure how to answer that. I don’t really remember another time that was clearly like this for weeks, at least not where I would’ve called it that. I’ve had bad stretches, I guess, like anyone, but… I don’t want to overstate it. This one feels more noticeable to me.
Can you think back and say for sure that you’ve had another time in your life, before this current period, when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row?

I don’t think I can say for sure, no. Like… I’ve had times where I was sad or stressed, but I’m not confident it was two full weeks in a row or that I really lost interest in things the way you mean. I don’t want to give you the wrong answer just to be helpful.
Have you ever had a period of time when you felt unusually high, overly energetic, or so confident that it was out of character for you, even if it felt good at the time?

Um… maybe, yeah. Earlier this month I had a few days where I felt kind of… lit up, I guess? Like really confident and like I could handle anything, which isn’t exactly normal for me.

I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, because at first it felt good. But I did notice I was also getting irritated really easily — like snapping at my mom or my supervisor over little questions that normally wouldn’t bother me. I felt bad about it after.
When you felt that unusually high and energetic earlier this month, did that last for at least four days in a row?

I think so… I mean, I’m a little nervous about saying it wrong, but the more obvious up-and-down has been going on for about a month now, since the mortgage stuff started feeling real. That charged-up stretch was part of that.
When you felt unusually high or energized earlier this month, did you also find yourself needing less sleep, talking faster than usual, or feeling like your thoughts were racing?

Yeah… the sleep part, I think so. I don’t want to overstate it, but there were several nights where I only slept maybe three or four hours, and then I still got up feeling kind of charged, like I didn’t even need coffee. Is that the kind of thing you mean?

When you were feeling that unusually high and energized earlier this month, did you also feel like you had special abilities, were more important than usual, or found yourself doing a lot of things at once, maybe even things that could be risky or out of character for you?

Yeah… I mean, I wouldn’t say I thought I was, like, special-special or anything. But I did get this really strong feeling that I could just handle everything if I pushed hard enough.

Like I honestly started thinking I could pay the condo down really fast, pass the CPA exams, and maybe run a little bookkeeping business on the side… like failure just wasn’t really an option. Saying it out loud, it sounds kind of unrealistic, but at the time it felt motivating, not weird. Is that what you mean?

During that time earlier this month when you felt unusually high or energized, did you also experience racing thoughts, pressured speech, or an increase in goal-directed activity such as taking on multiple new projects or tasks?

Yeah… I guess mostly the taking-on-more-things part. I started emailing people about maybe doing their books, and I was making lists for condo projects, and calling relatives to talk through plans way more than I normally would.

It didn’t feel bad at the time, more like I was being productive, but… yeah, it was probably more than my usual. Does that answer it?
